exposure: history of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASIS)
outcome: Pelvic Organ Prolapse/Urinary Incontinence Sexual Questionnaire-12 (PISQ-12) score
cohort: 318 women (140 with a history of primary repaired OASIS and 178 women without OASIS)
finding: Women with a history of OASIS after spontaneous delivery had a lower rate of coital resumption and worse sexual function at 6 months postpartum compared to women without OASIS.
mod_finding: Women with OVD resumed coital activity later and had lower PISQ-12 scores compared to women with SD, regardless of OASIS history.
